digest.component_or_area: BindingStore persistence and rotation state management
propositions: The inline last_get_pass field must be removed from bindings.json after a successful new-writer save, with sidecar rotation state persisted first.
Sidecar persistence must complete before inline field scrubbing; if sidecar write fails, the primary binding save must succeed with the latest inline value retained as a failure floor.
A crash or failure after sidecar replacement but before bindings replacement must not lose the maximum rotation timestamp; the maximum must already be durable in the sidecar file.
Mixed old-writer and new-writer sequences must converge by promoting the chronological maximum of any reintroduced inline timestamp into get_rotation.json before scrubbing.
All writer processes must be refreshed to A2-1-or-newer binaries before A2-2 closure, verified through descendant reconcile-bridge run SHA and explicit host probe binary refresh.
